description: I have been working on several personal projects that showcase my skills and expertise in web development. I am learning NextJS, Typescript and containerization using Docker. Built several projects while learning these technologies.

I have been working as a full stack developer at Explorator Labs, where I have been responsible for developing and maintaining web applications. I have worked on a variety of projects, including a social media platform, a project management tool, and an e-commerce website. I have experience with a wide range of technologies, including React, Ruby on Rails, PostgreSQL, and Cypress. The projects I have worked on have been deployed using CI/CD pipelines, and I have experience working in an agile environment. Unforunately, I have been laid off due to the client's budget constraints despite receiving consistent positive feedback.
Mentored 2 developers, reviewed code for consistency and performance, and proposed improvements, boosting efficiency by 15% and achieving 100% retention rate.

Developed responsive front-end designs for 3 web apps, ensuring cross-browser compatibility. Optimized load times by 30% through minification and image compression. Collaborated with 5 team members to develop a key feature using agile practices.
